description: Na₂P₃HO₉ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.57 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.59 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.66 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.06 Å) and one longer (1.46 Å) H-O bond length. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom.
